notes.title: Art Update 7/4/25
notes.content:
As we reach the end of the Design Professionals Course, IFF is receiving an artistic update with a brand-new player model and level textures! The work comes courtesy of the very talented Carla Narvaez, who has been working on her own game over the last four months as well.

Feel free to check out the Steam page for her game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3788260/Street_Errands/]Street Errands[/url].

Even with the class ending, I still intend to build upon IFF's content going into the future. I'm proud of the work I've done so far, but that's all the more reason to keep improving!

notes.title: Update 6/15/25
notes.content:
Quick patch for the last day of GamesCon Canada 2025.

-Minor visual change to player model to increase clarity of direction.
-Added an "Enemies Remaining" counter to the Heads-Up Display.

tags.feature: -Added an "Enemies Remaining" counter to the Heads-Up Display.

notes.title: Update for 6/14/25
notes.content:
IFF is released, but the work is far from done! I'll be continuing to make improvements to the project, starting with some fixes to address feedback from players who have been trying out the game up at GamesCon Canada 2025.

-Cannon cooldown shortened from 3 seconds to 2 seconds.
-Rifle grunt firing cooldown increased from 1 second to 1.5 seconds.
-Animation for melee grunt has been trimmed to remove glaring gap in attack.
-Animation for grenadier has also been trimmed, but to look less jarring.
-Player rotation speed increased from 60 to 75.
-Players now receive notification when all enemies have been cleared from a level.
